title: Versioned README archives and publication records
summary: Expose approved guides, historical homepage states, changelogs, and pinned sources from the README HQ version index.
acceptance_criteria: Each archived homepage record links to its version and publication or draft status.
A reviewer can trace imported documents to the recorded Git source.

evidence.claim: The active index separates guide records and project homepage records.
The history index links to the archive provenance manifest.
